nodes.label: UzCasting Logo System
nodes.rationale: Sources in assets/brand (logo.svg 512x512 viewBox, logo-source.png 4096x4096). Mark is a UZ monogram with a play triangle and film strip; gradient #6F20FF -> #A72DFF -> #E33CFF matching the TZ Neon Purple / Magenta.

nodes.label: Vector Where Possible, Raster Only Where Forced
nodes.rationale: SVG inside the app via react-native-svg-transformer: any size without blur, 5 KB instead of 1.9 MB, gradient stays live. PNG only for what the OS renders (app icon, splash), because Android/iOS accept raster only.

nodes.label: Platform Icon Constraints
nodes.rationale: iOS icons must not be transparent; the Android adaptive-icon safe zone is ~66% of the side, so the foreground logo is scaled to 62% or the mask clips it. Icons are regenerated by script with transparent-edge trimming rather than resized by hand.
